messages:
jess_customer: Hey team — our production app started seeing requests routed to EU edge even though our SDK sets region='us-west'. Latency spiked from ~45ms to ~320ms. Anyone seen this?

sam_support: Sorry about that. Can you share the exact SDK call and a sample request id?

jess_customer: JS SDK call:
```js
client.request({ model: 'redwood-2', region: 'us-west' })
```
Sample req id: req_7f2b9a

sam_support: Looking at router logs for req_7f2b9a — x-client-region header exists but value is empty string (""), and X-Forwarded-Region is set to "eu" by an upstream proxy. Current routing gives priority to a present header even if empty, so router favored EU.

devon_sre: To add context: routing precedence was intended to be header > query param > account default, but we weren't handling empty/whitespace header values as "absent". That makes proxies that inject an empty header break region selection.

maria_eng: I reproduced locally. This curl shows the behavior:
```bash
curl -H "x-client-region:" -H "X-Forwarded-Region: eu" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/open?region=us-west"
```
Router picked EU. If header omitted entirely, region=us-west wins.

jess_customer: Our cloud LB replaces untrusted client headers with an empty header rather than dropping them. So SDK sent both header+query param, LB zeroes the header and sets X-Forwarded-Region. Oops.

sam_support: Short-term mitigations: (1) set region explicitly in query param (we treat non-empty query param as fallback but wins over empty header until we patch), or (2) set Authorization-level metadata with region. Longer term we'll fix router to ignore empty/whitespace headers.

maria_eng: I'll open a small patch to treat empty or whitespace-only header values as absent in routing logic. Test added. Target: patch branch -> canary -> prod today.

devon_sre: I'll add an alert in edge logs to detect requests with present-but-empty x-client-region and mismatched X-Forwarded-Region so we can identify affected customers and backfill recent traffic.

sam_support: @jess_customer we'll keep you updated. No billing adjustments on our side for the EU egress. ETA for patch rollout: ~6 hours. We'll post PR and release notes.

deploy-bot: [deploy] routing-service patch deployed to staging at 2026-03-17T16:12:09Z — CI green.

maria_eng: Merged fix to main. Canary starting.

devon_sre: Canary shows misroutes down 100% on canaries. Scheduling full rollout in 8 minutes.

sam_support: @jess_customer can you confirm routing looks normal from your side after the rollout? If yes, we'll close INC-4720.

jess_customer: Confirmed — traffic back to us-west, latency back to ~50ms. Thanks all!

sam_support: Closing loop — incident closed. Thanks :thumbsup:
